figures.title: Age structure changes country comparisons
figures.takeaway: Heart country-rank agreement is only ρ=0.252 after age adjustment.

figures.title: Country ranking agreement by cause group
figures.takeaway: Brain country death rankings have crude-versus-ASDR ρ=0.030.

figures.title: Organ ranking agreement within countries
figures.takeaway: Within-country organ death rankings are more stable, with median ρ=0.978.

figures.title: Eight observed global time points
figures.takeaway: Global lung death ASDR in 2021 is 83.7% above observed 2019.

figures.title: Country ASDR changes from 2000 to 2019
figures.takeaway: The median country heart death-ASDR change from 2000 to 2019 is -20.1%.

figures.title: COVID-19 and the mapped lung increase
figures.takeaway: COVID exceeds the net mapped lung increase because other mapped lung causes decline.

figures.title: Two descriptive country patterns
figures.takeaway: The selected k=2 summarizes profiles with method-dependent membership.

figures.title: Separation and bootstrap stability for k=2..8
figures.takeaway: k=2 has silhouette 0.229 and median bootstrap ARI 0.936.

figures.title: Profiles of the descriptive patterns
figures.takeaway: Pattern 1 has higher relative small_intestine, maternal_neonatal, lungs features; pattern 2 has higher colon_rectum, pancreas, bladder features.

figures.title: Broad-bin versus published fine-age deaths ASDR
figures.takeaway: brain has the largest median broad-bin underestimate (-15.02%) among the mapped groups in 2023.

figures.title: Changing the standard population
figures.takeaway: The weakest country-rank agreement across alternative standards is ρ=0.921, for blood_immune deaths under Segi.

figures.title: Global organ rankings under five standards
figures.takeaway: Segi switches the top global death-ASDR group from heart to lungs compared with WHO2026.

figures.title: Alternative cause attribution
figures.takeaway: Moving diabetes to pancreas changes its global death-ASDR rank from 16 to 7 while totals stay constant.

figures.title: Male/female standardized burden ratios
figures.takeaway: Global mental/substance male/female ratios are 3.56 for deaths and 1.03 for DALYs.
